name: delivery-stop-card
title: Delivery stop card
description: One stop on a delivery route: sequence marker, recipient and address, time window and parcels, with call, navigate and outcome actions.
docs: sequence is the stop's number, written in a marker; address is { recipient, lines, notes? }; window is { from, to }, written in locale and timeZone ('12:30 – 13:00') and read as 'Delivery window'; parcels counts the parcels. status is upcoming, next, delivered, failed or skipped. The next stop is emphasised, carries a 'Next stop' badge and aria-current='step', and gets large Call (onCall), Navigate (onNavigate) and Delivered buttons, with Could not deliver and Skip one tap away in a menu; every outcome is reported through onStatusChange('delivered' | 'failed' | 'skipped'). An upcoming stop shows Call and Navigate. A stop that is done mutes and says what happened in its badge, in words and with the time ('Delivered at 11:52', from completedAt), shows reason in a callout (an error one when it failed), and offers Undo, which reports 'upcoming' so that you decide which stop is next. The card is one stop and keeps no order of its own: put them in a list, and in a sortable list for route planning. Every change of status is said once in a polite status line ('Stop 3, Sana Haddad: Delivered at 11:52'), and when the control that had focus leaves the card, focus stays inside it: on Undo after an outcome, on the first action after Undo, on the card itself when it has none. Focus you have moved on yourself, to the next stop, is left where you put it. labels carries every word.
